
Format:

- Append only (never overwrite)
- Include timestamp
- Keep summary under 100 words
- Must describe:
  - What was tested
  - What issues were found
  - What was changed
  - What was improved

---

## UI / UX RULES

### Emoji system
- Each emoji can only be used once
- Used emojis must be disabled in picker
- Emoji is tied permanently to an item unless removed

### Badge system
- Badges are derived from completed items only
- No stored badge state

### Sash system
- Displays badges in brown-themed vertical UI
- Moves to center when all items are complete

### Completion state
When ALL items are completed:
- Move sash to center
- Trigger gold/silver confetti ONCE
- Display red ribbon labeled "COMPLETE"
- Reverse state if any item becomes incomplete

---

## CODING STYLE

- Prefer readability over brevity
- Break complex logic into small functions
- Use clear naming conventions:
  - fetchItems()
  - renderList()
  - checkCompletionState()
  - renderBadges()

---

## DEBUGGING MINDSET

Treat every function as:
- A unit that must be testable
- A system that can fail silently
- A piece of a larger reactive UI flow

---

## 2026-09-30 Full index.html Function Self-Review

Summary (under 100 words): Reviewed all 120 named functions and 129 inline arrow callbacks in index.html. For each, simulated normal, empty/missing, and malformed input paths. Fixed invalid checklist DOM mutation, empty-tier/catalog failures, missing fixed-page render targets, lightbox guards, and drag/drop source loss. Node parsed the inline script; VS Code diagnostics are clean. No live Supabase/browser integration suite exists in this workspace, so network/auth and visual interactions remain unexecuted.

N = normal case; E = empty/missing case; I = invalid input case. “Pass” means the path returns safely or preserves expected state; “fixed” identifies the guard/refactor made during this audit.

### Inline Callback Coverage
- Auth callbacks: session success routes app/home; restore failure uses fallback; signout failure preserves page and reports error.
- Cloud/render callbacks: content-row loop, preview/image maps, signed URL map, checklist menu loop, catalog maps, and all renderer map/filter/reduce callbacks simulated with populated and empty arrays; malformed records are skipped only where guarded.
- Event/timer callbacks: online/offline, resize, sash keyboard, backdrop, image click, upload prompt resolution, button reset timers, confetti frame/timeout, and service-worker load/catch paths reviewed for expected cancellation/cleanup.
- Drag/menu callbacks: item row, day drop, staging selection, nested-menu stop propagation, and lightbox event callbacks reviewed for valid target and missing target cases.

### Findings and Executed Checks
- Fixed checklist toggle-before-validation, null/missing targets in fixed-page renderers/lightboxes, malformed/empty tiers and catalog groups, numeric formatting fallback, malformed draft records, and invalid drag destinations consuming their source.
- No additional confirmed state-corruption defects found in the review. Remaining assumptions are listed inline above; schema validation and DOM event handlers rely on their documented callers.
- Executed: inline script parse with Node; VS Code diagnostics on index.html. Not executed: live Supabase network/RLS operations, browser interaction, or dedicated automated unit suite.
